answers_review: ts23_review2.json (verdict FAIL: G1 surviving mutation, G2 false-red mutation receipts)
admission: Review 2 was right on both counts, and G2 is a defect in what I reported: my first mutation harness replaced main() with a body referencing names that did not exist, so the three 'caught' results were NameError / missing-fixture failures. I reported them as behaviour detection. They were not.

changes.finding: G1 - the agent test accepted entirely incorrect non-negative byte counts; a bytes=0 mutation survived with exit 0
changes.fix: test_agent.py now compares [r['bytes'] for r in data['reviews']] with [len(Path(x).read_bytes()) for x in queue[:2]], and applies the same exact oracle to the --max-steps 1 result
changes.evidence: mutation case D (agent reports bytes=0 per file) now fails with an AssertionError; it exited 0 before this change

changes.finding: G2 - ts23_test_strength.json all_caught=true did not establish behavioural detection
changes.fix: the harness was rewritten: each mutation is a single textual substitution in the REAL installed source, so the mutant is self-contained and wrong in exactly one respect. It now records failure_kind and only counts a mutation as caught when the exit is non-zero AND the failure is an AssertionError. Non-assertion failures are recorded as false_red and make the run fail.
changes.evidence: 5 mutations, 5 caught as AssertionError, 0 false reds, 5/5 restored byte-identical, unmutated baseline passes for all three tests
mutations: census reports bytes=0 for a non-empty file
headings are fixture constants regardless of the document
agent reports bytes=0 per file (the one that survived review 2)
agent reports remaining=0 while a file is still queued

changes.finding: the harness's own fixture path was wrong, which the baseline check exposed
changes.fix: pointed at ts23_tests/headings.md, the file the build actually uses; baseline_all_pass is now part of the receipt so a wrong harness cannot look like a passing one again

unchanged: checks 3 (behavioural RED), 5 (hermetic venv) and 4 (positive controls) passed in review 2 and were not touched
the requirement is still one small local tool set
claim_ceiling: Remediated with reproducible evidence, and my earlier '3/3 caught' claim is withdrawn as a false red. M2 still needs a THIRD independent read: the maker cannot accept its own remediation, and a reviewer who was wrong once is exactly why the next read must be fresh.
